text:
lina: FYI a customer hit a weird case: their webhook connector returned a response that passed model-level checks but failed our structured-output gate and the router routed it to a degen variant. They got an `invalid_shape` in logs and asked why they were billed.

samir: Which connector + model? Any sample payload?

lina: connector: salesforce-create, model: open-sim-2. We got: `{"op":"create","params":["acct-77","Priority issue"]}` — note `params` is an array, schema expects `{account_id, title}`.

andre: Router currently applies the schema gate pre-routing and treats mismatches as hard rejects -> fallback. That explains the degen routing.

megan: Console gap: we surface token/cost but not the specific reject reason. Customers see cost spikes and get support tickets.

dev-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: schema_mismatch spike on prod-west-2 (4m window)

terry: Two related problems: 1) visibility (why it failed), 2) UX + privacy (do we show raw request?). Suggestion: add `validation.reason` and `validation.hint` to trace/span metadata and expose an opt-in per-org detail view.

andre: Engineering idea: expose metric `validation.schema_mismatch_total{route,model,env}` and a secondary `validation.coercion_applied_total`. Build a tiny adapter coercion lib with reversible ops (array->object by positional mapping only when mapping is exact).

samir: Billing note: model tokens for initial attempt are billed. If router performs a fallback attempt (degen/alt-model) that's billed separately. We need a clear support policy for cases where the primary output is rejected by our validation layer.

megan: UI proposal: in Console Request Details show a redacted excerpt + a short human-friendly reason ("structured output mismatch: args should be object, got array"). Have an org-settings toggle: "Show validation hints (requires consent)". Default: off.

lina: Rollout plan idea: run a non-blocking "observe" mode that records validation outcomes but does not alter routing. Controlled by header `x-validate-mode: observe` and config `validation.observe_sampling`. Example: `validation: {mode: observe, sample: 0.02, coercion: [positional_array_to_obj]}`

terry: For safety, coercion ops default to conservative transforms only; any transform that guesses keys is disabled. Enterprise customers must opt-in for coercion. Log reversible diff so we can revert.

andre: Implementation tasks: 1) add span enrichment + metrics, 2) implement adapter coercion library and reversible diffs, 3) router header + sampling control, 4) unit/integration tests covering QoS.

megan: I'll wire mockups for Console detail, the org toggle, and the privacy consent flow. Also draft a concise support KB for billing/credits.

samir: I'll update billing docs and draft support playbook for credit requests where validation misclassified the output.

lina: Ok owners: andre (prototype metrics + coercion lib), terry (router header + config), megan (Console + privacy), samir (billing & support). Dev-bot please create an incident channel if spike continues. Sync in 1h to review prototypes. Thanks everyone.
